description: The LOD3 Road Space Models repository provides semantic geometry for streets in central Ingolstadt, Germany. Its README distinguishes an OpenDRIVE 1.4 road network with roadside objects, CityGML 2.0 and 3.0 versions converted from that network, over 50 manually modelled LoD3 buildings and four LoD2 building tiles. The building models use mobile laser-scanning point clouds that the provider describes as having relative accuracy of 1 to 3 centimetres; this is not an independently checked accuracy guarantee for every object. Coverage is the modelled inner-city area, with separate component extents. The public repository supplies access metadata. Road-network components use CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, LoD3 buildings use CC BY-SA 4.0 and LoD2 buildings use CC BY 4.0. Caveats include mixed licences and detail levels, so one licence does not apply to every component. TUM's directory describes resimulating an Ingolstadt drive and LiDAR sensor in CARLA for TrueCity, establishing a concrete role for semantic street environments in simulation. Related TrueCity records describe the paired measured and simulated observations. Repository files and models were not downloaded.
